source.title: Erdős-Macintyre type theorem’s for multiple Dirichlet series: exceptional sets and open problems

accepted.question_text: Let f(z)=∑_{n=0}∞ a_n z^n be a nonconstant entire function, let M_f(r)=max{|f(z)|: |z|=r}, and let μ_f(r)=max_{n≥0}|a_n|r^n. For a fixed ε>0, Wiman's inequality is M_f(r)≤μ_f(r)(ln μ_f(r))^(1/2+ε) for all r outside an exceptional set E⊂[1,∞). Given an arbitrary set E=∪_{n=1}∞[a_n,b_n] of finite logarithmic measure ∫_E d ln r<∞, can one find an entire function f for which E can serve as the exceptional set in Wiman's inequality for that ε?

Let f(z)=∑_{n=0}∞ a_n z^n be a nonconstant entire function, let M_f(r)=max{|f(z)|: |z|=r}, and let μ_f(r)=max_{n≥0}|a_n|r^n. For a fixed ε>0, Wiman's inequality is M_f(r)≤μ_f(r)(ln μ_f(r))^(1/2+ε) for all r outside an exceptional set E. If E=∪_{n=1}∞[a_n,b_n] satisfies ∫_E (ln r)^(1/2) d ln r<∞, does every such set E occur as an exceptional set for Wiman's inequality for some entire function f and that ε?

Let p≥1 and let F∈D_p(λ^p) be an entire function on C^p represented by an absolutely convergent multiple Dirichlet series F(z)=∑_{n∈Z_+^p} a_n exp(<z,λ_n>), where λ_n=(λ^{(1)}_{n1},...,λ^{(p)}_{np}) and each coordinate exponent sequence tends to +∞. For x∈R^p define M(x,F)=sup{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, m(x,F)=inf{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, and μ(x,F)=max{|a_n|exp(<x,λ_n>) : n∈Z_+^p}. Under the coordinate gap conditions ∑_{k=0}∞ 1/(λ^{(j)}_{k+1}-λ^{(j)}_k)<∞ for every j=1,...,p, is finiteness of τ_p(E)=∫_{E∖B_p(1)} dx_1...dx_p/|x|^(p−1) the best possible size description for exceptional sets E outside which M(x,F)=(1+o(1))μ(x,F) and M(x,F)=(1+o(1))m(x,F) hold as |x|→∞?

Let p≥1 and let F∈D_p(λ^p) be an entire function on C^p represented by an absolutely convergent multiple Dirichlet series F(z)=∑_{n∈Z_+^p} a_n exp(<z,λ_n>). For x∈R^p define M(x,F)=sup{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, m(x,F)=inf{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, and μ(x,F)=max{|a_n|exp(<x,λ_n>) : n∈Z_+^p}. Given a positive differentiable function h:R_+→R_+ with h'(t) increasing to +∞, what conditions on F and its exponent system λ^p guarantee that M(x,F)=(1+o(1))μ(x,F) and M(x,F)=(1+o(1))m(x,F) hold as |x|→∞ outside some set E with finite h–τ_p measure ∫_E h'(|x|) dx_1...dx_p/|x|^(p−1)<∞?

For entire multiple Dirichlet series F∈D_p(λ^p), define M(x,F)=sup{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, m(x,F)=inf{|F(x+iy)|: y∈R^p}, and μ(x,F)=max{|a_n|exp(<x,λ_n>) : n∈Z_+^p}. Suppose the coordinate exponent sequences satisfy ∑_{k=0}∞ 1/(λ^{(j)}_{k+1}-λ^{(j)}_k)<∞ for every j=1,...,p. Is the estimate meas_p(E∩B_p(r))=O(r^(p−1)) as r→∞ the best possible description of exceptional sets E for which M(x,F)=(1+o(1))μ(x,F) and M(x,F)=(1+o(1))m(x,F) hold outside E as |x|→∞?
